creators: Tool: ODOS lockfile-to-SPDX generator (local script, not part of the repository)
creationInfo.comment: Generated from backend/requirements.lock, frontend/package-lock.json, the Dockerfiles and compose.yaml of develop at e600640. Python licenses and requirements come from PyPI metadata plus manual license review; npm data comes from package-lock.json. Docker images are listed by tag only and the three apt packages have no pinned version; operating-system packages inside the images are not enumerated. setuptools and websockets are not pinned in requirements.lock; their versions were observed in locally built backend images. licenseConcluded is NOASSERTION throughout.

packages.description: ODOS frontend (React, Vite, TypeScript). Dependencies: frontend/package-lock.json

packages.licenseComments: Debian bookworm fonts-liberation 1:1.07.4-11 (debian/copyright) ships Liberation 1.x under the GNU GPL v2 with a font exception, not OFL-1.1; no single SPDX expression was assigned, needs review

packages.name: faker

packages.licenseComments: PyPI license_expression. Expression comes from PyPI metadata and covers bundled third-party code.

packages.name: olefile

packages.name: omegaconf

packages.name: opencv-python-headless
packages.licenseComments: reviewed override: PyPI license text 'Apache 2.0'; deps.dev reports Apache-2.0. The wheel bundles third-party libraries with their own licenses (see LICENSE-3RD-PARTY.txt in the wheel).

packages.name: pillow
packages.licenseComments: PyPI license_expression. MIT-CMU (HPND-style permissive license) requires keeping the copyright and permission notice.

packages.name: psycopg
packages.licenseComments: PyPI license_expression. LGPL-3.0-only (weak copyleft). Used unmodified as an imported library; distributing the Docker image carries LGPL-3.0 license-text and source obligations.

packages.name: psycopg-binary
packages.licenseComments: PyPI license_expression. LGPL-3.0-only (weak copyleft). Binary wheel of psycopg bundling libpq and OpenSSL; used unmodified; distributing the Docker image carries LGPL-3.0 license-text and source obligations.

packages.name: pypdfium2
packages.licenseComments: reviewed override: PyPI declares 'BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, dependency licenses'; the wheel ships Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause and CC-BY-4.0 texts. AND is a conservative reading of that list. Bundled PDFium and its dependencies carry further licenses (see the LICENSES folder in the wheel); needs legal review for the notices.

packages.name: python-dateutil
packages.licenseComments: reviewed override: shipped LICENSE contains the Apache-2.0 text and a BSD text stating the BSD license applies to all code also covered by Apache 2.0; PyPI says 'Dual License'. AND is a conservative reading. Dual-licensed; either license may be satisfied in practice, the expression lists both.

packages.name: s3transfer
packages.licenseComments: reviewed override: PyPI license 'Apache License 2.0'; deps.dev reports Apache-2.0

packages.name: safetensors
packages.licenseComments: reviewed override: shipped LICENSE text is the Apache License 2.0 (same version); PyPI classifier Apache Software License

packages.name: scipy
packages.licenseComments: reviewed override: shipped LICENSE.txt starts with the 3-clause BSD text (same version); PyPI classifier BSD License. The wheel additionally bundles third-party components under other licenses (see LICENSE.txt in the wheel).

packages.name: shellingham
packages.licenseComments: reviewed override: PyPI license 'ISC License'; deps.dev reports ISC

packages.name: sympy
packages.licenseComments: reviewed override: shipped LICENSE (same version) is the 3-clause BSD text; PyPI says BSD. Also bundles code under other licenses (see LICENSE in the wheel).

packages.name: tokenizers
packages.licenseComments: reviewed override: LOW CONFIDENCE: only the PyPI classifier 'Apache Software License' is available; deps.dev says non-standard and no license text was read. Apache-2.0 assumed from the classifier

packages.licenseDeclared: Apache-2.0 AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSL-1.0 AND MIT
packages.licenseComments: PyPI license_expression. Expression comes from the wheel metadata and covers bundled third-party code; the PyTorch CPU wheel from download.pytorch.org (used in Docker) was not inspected.
